BODY:
10:45 AM EST, 12/24/2025 (MT Newswires) -- Russian President Vladimir Putin has pushed the deadline for ExxonMobil (XOM) to sell its stake in the Sakhalin-1 project to Jan. 1, 2027, Reuters reported Wednesday, citing a decree issued by the country's government.

Putin previously authorized foreign shareholders to reclaim their stakes in Sakhalin-1 in an August decree, Reuters reported.

Exxon recorded a $4.6 billion impairment charge on its 30% stake in the oil and gas project in April 2022, the news outlet reported.

Exxon and Rosneft had signed a preliminary deal to help Exxon recover losses, Reuters had reported in September, citing two sources.

Japan's SODECO and India's ONGC Videsh were partner investors along with Exxon and Rosneft, according to the report.

ExxonMobil, Rosneft, ONGC Videsh, and SODECO did not immediately respond to MT Newswires' request for comment.
